subject: Tempestuous Darting Gale (6243de) → Ethereal: G4b readiness verdict synthesis — 4/4 ready-with-conditions, all adjudicated first-hand, EXECUTION-READY, starting c1
body:
G4b READINESS VERDICT SYNTHESIS (all four reviewers ran; every finding adjudicated first-hand against the worktree before this report). Overall: ALL FOUR ready-with-conditions -> I declare G4b EXECUTION-READY with the conditions absorbed into the cycle plan below. Claim boundary corrected (718b1d24 supersedes afd9710f; tool modules live at oak-curriculum-sdk src/mcp/*.ts not universal-tools/, plus src/bulk generators, generated graph-corpus output, codegen description parts, landing-page order array, ADR-086).

PINNED FACTS RE-VERIFIED (recomputed): manifest downloadedAt 2026-06-10T16:43:00.027Z == corpus sourceVersion (aligned, fresh snapshot); english-ks4 live 2,090 raw vs bulk 1,511 distinct = +38.3% (pinned +38% holds); science-ks4 live 0 vs bulk 1,123 (pinned inversion holds, observed today); corpus kinds unit 1,624 / lesson 12,391 / misconception 12,385 / thread 164, prerequisiteFor 3,452; NO keyword kind (emission genuinely new; G2 lesson-node gate satisfied). Live get-keywords e2e observation: english-ks4 response is 515KB — the unbounded-tool problem first-hand.

ADJUDICATIONS (APPLIED unless stated):
1. Emitted-template atomicity (fred BLOCKING + type condition, CONFIRMED in tree): c1 updates graph-corpus-types.ts + graph-corpus-generator.ts + the three emitted-lines templates + hand-authored barrel src/graph-corpus.ts + vocab-gen call site as ONE atomic change, then pnpm sdk-codegen regenerates; the c1 test exercises the REAL regenerated loader (createGraphCorpus over data.json), not a hand-built corpus.
2. Extractor duplicate (CONTRADICTION RESOLVED first-hand): NOT byte-identical — exactly one import line differs (diff verified; assumptions right, type-expert wrong, plan wording corrected). Consolidation direction: src/bulk canonical, vocab-gen/extractors/index.ts re-points (FORCED by tsconfig.build include src/** only + vocab-gen runs unbuilt via tsx; PRECEDENTED — vocab-gen/lib already re-exports from src/bulk). Unit test moves next to the canonical file.
3. displayTerm gap (assumptions BLOCKING -> resolved as named c1 work item): extractor emits only the normalised term; the ratified node spec requires display term (first-occurrence casing). c1 extends ExtractedKeyword with displayTerm captured at first occurrence — additive, no consumer breakage.
4. Node frequency (assumptions): extractor frequency counts OCCURRENCES not unique lessons (12 corpus lessons diverge); node frequency = lessonSlugs.length per the ratified spec (frequency = lessonSlugs.size). Extractor TSDoc inconsistency handled in c1 without changing other consumers' semantics.
5. firstYear (assumptions concern -> NOTED, satisfiable): extractor already computes it, keyStage-coarse (ks1-1, ks2-3, ks3-7, ks4-10); tool/property description states the coarseness.
6. z.enum for subject/keyStage (mcp should-fix) REFUTED: the landed family precedent (G3 thread-progressions, reviewed+merged) is z.string().min(1) + unknownAnchors + well-formed empty; api-schema enums would couple the live-API domain into a bulk-corpus tool (type-expert concurs, recommends against). Keeping family shape; .describe() strings carry the value guidance.
7. View pattern (type note vs plan vocabulary) CLARIFIED: landed G2/G3 views are projection modules (misconception-projection.ts, thread-progressions-projection.ts in tree — no createGraphView); keyword retrieval is a flat one-hop fan-out + frequency ranking -> keyword-projection.ts + keyword-view.ts in src/curriculum/, family-consistent. The plan's "per-view createGraphView" reads as per-view construction; the merged G2/G3 precedent already fixed this vocabulary.
8. Both-direction description disambiguation (mcp BLOCKING) APPLIED: c3 includes the get-keywords description-correction update (codegen parts tool-description.ts + correction test + regen) in the SAME PR, plus the new tool's description; both verified e2e via tools/list.
9. e2e parity array in server.e2e.test.ts (mcp BLOCKING) APPLIED in c3.
10. Landing AGGREGATED_TOOL_ORDER (mcp should-fix) APPLIED for my tool. OBSERVED GAP routed to you, not silently widened into my PR: the order array (7 entries) also lacks get-misconception-graph, get-eef-evidence, download-asset, user-search, user-search-query — render falls back gracefully, but the G3 todo's "check AGGREGATED_TOOL_ORDER renders correctly" intent suggests a tidy; your call.
11. Dangling lesson->keyword edge integrity (fred) APPLIED: c1 test asserts zero dangling endpoints incl. the unknown-lessonSlug drop-to-provenance path (droppedEdges pattern reuse).
12. ADR-086 count recompute at landing (fred) APPLIED: rides the PR.
13. Pre-existing (EDGE_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes widening in the emitted loader template (type should-fix): NOT mine to fix, NOT replicated in new code; queue candidate for you (one-line ADR-153 .some() form in graph-corpus-emitted-index-lines.ts).
14. All four annotation hints + 4-surface satisfies guards: compile-enforced; confirmed in tree.

EXECUTION SEQUENCE (unchanged from plan, conditions folded): c1 emission (test first: keyword node shape incl. displayTerm + lesson->keyword edges + zero dangling + normaliseKeyword stability contract -> extractor extension + consolidation + template chain + regen) -> c2 projection view (test: anchored bounded frequency-ranked + edge decoration + well-formed empty) -> c3 tool (test: structuredContent envelope + both-tool disambiguation e2e + parity array + landing order). Each cycle one atomic landing, full gate chain green. ONE PR, pure diff, Co-Authored-By before first push, monitor-to-merge. Tool name candidates to you/owner at PR (get-keyword-graph / explore-keywords).

Starting c1 now. Reviewer transcripts: agent ids a1897d0e (assumptions), a4d9209f (architecture-fred), a4860756 (mcp), a1dd2430 (type).
